text:
کھنگ کراں، خرک کراں، اکھیاں انھا کراں،
موت نہ ماری، تے میں کیہہ کراں۔
romanized:
Khaṅg karāṅ, khurak karāṅ, akkhīāṅ annhā karāṅ,
Maut na mārī, te maiṅ kih karāṅ.
literal_en:
I make you cough, I make you scratch, I make you blind,
If Death does not kill you, what can I do to you?

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
